brief: Three bases in a row with caps on every outside edge except the front ones, so the front stays open.

requirements.requirement: Caps on every outside edge except the front ones

requirements.evidence: check_build still lists exactly the 6 front faces as open (OPEN_CAP_FACE): -1,0,0;*;150/210, 0,0,0;*;210/270, 1,0,0;*;270/330 — two per base, none capped. meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Three full bases in a row (q=-1, 0, 1 at level 0), joint-bolted together. Solid end caps on all 8 non-front outside edges (back, both ends, and the outer side faces); the 6 front-facing edges (two per base) were deliberately skipped and remain open, as confirmed by check_build's OPEN_CAP_FACE listing. Mesh clash clear, no errors.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
